property: manager/agent management framework, structured managed information, protocol operations, instrumentation and administrative structure evolve into the explicitly componentized SNMPv2 framework

sources.locator: Introduction and Components of the SNMPv2 Framework
sources.supports: RFC 1441 explicitly says SNMPv2 is derived from the original Internet-standard Network Management Framework and enumerates the SNMPv1 components.

negative_claims: This edge does not imply a single-document replacement; SNMPv1 and SNMPv2 are multi-document frameworks.
It does not erase coexistence and compatibility mechanisms.
open_questions: Split the SNMPv2 framework into SMI, protocol, administration, security and coexistence sub-lineages.
